ios.desc:
Hourly. Daily. Weekly. Monthly. Yearly. Lifetime. One app.

Accumoo is the goal tracker and habit builder that's serious enough for power users but simple enough for anyone to start. Set your schedule, set your goals, and let Accumoo keep you accountable — whether you're tracking every hour or building toward something that lasts a lifetime.

BEYOND DAILY CHECKBOXES

Most habit apps stop at daily. Accumoo goes further — without leaving daily behind.

Posture check every hour. Meditation once a day. Resistance training 3x per week. Budget review every month. Certifications renewed every
year. Degrees earned over a lifetime.

Accumoo handles all of it. One system. Complete visibility. Real progress.

PERSONAL CHALLENGES

Turn everyday actions into timed, multi-day goals. See how many days you meet your target, and keep counting from iPhone, iPad, or Apple Watch. Start with one Novice Challenge free; Premium adds more simultaneous Challenges and higher difficulty levels.

BUILT FOR DISCIPLINE

  • Offline capable — Record progress without a connection, then sync when online
  • Flexible scheduling — Hourly, daily, weekly, monthly, yearly, or lifetime tracking
  • Goals optional — Set targets or simply count what matters
  • Streak tracking — See your consistency build over time
  • Home screen & lock screen widgets — 15 widgets to track goals without opening the app
  • Achievements — 18 badges across 5 categories to celebrate your progress
  • Habit templates — 48 ready-made templates across 8 categories to get started fast
  • Pause & resume — Freeze your streaks during breaks without losing progress
  • Share achievements — Show off rare and legendary badges on social media
  • Bulk count adjust — Add or subtract any amount with a single action
  • Encouragement — Motivational nudges that adapt to your goals and pace
  • Multi-device sync — Track across iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch
  • Missed period alerts — See when a goal period goes incomplete
  • Custom icons — Personalize every goal with 2,000+ icons and built-in search
  • Event history — Review past activity (30 days on Free; unlimited with Premium)
  • Powerful stats — Completion rates, trends, and insights

WHATEVER YOU'RE BUILDING

  • Fitness — Workouts, runs, gym sessions on YOUR schedule
  • Health — Symptoms, medications, wellness routines
  • Productivity — Dedicated work blocks, meetings, milestones
  • Learning — Study sessions, practice hours, certifications earned
  • Finance — No-spend

quotes.text:
Hi Everyone,

I created a mobile app called Accumoo, and I would appreciate it if y'all can have a look, download and give me a favorable review. Lots of blood, sweat, tears and love went into this app, and I hope you LOVE it as much as I do - it's the app I always needed and wanted. Anyhow, I've been a Rails developer and Software Engineer for a long time, and this is my first stab at a mobile app. It's a "habit tracker" app on steroids that's just fun to use - syncs across devices, local-first architecture - and an easter egg game for good measure.

Help a disabled vet out and give it a go.

Thank you in advance.
GA
